status: PREREGISTERED BUDGETS — no Quick Access measurement has been executed as of 2026-11-19. Filled results belong in evidence/ (git-ignored), copied from fixtures/quick-access/bench-evidence.template.md.

method.machine: named Windows 11 reference machine, AC power
method.reporting: percentiles (p50/p95/p99), min/max, sample count, hardware, build, and baseline for every row
method.separation: keep cold launch, unlock/KDF, and warm summon as separate measurements; protective settings (key zeroization, VirtualLock, watchdog, KDF cost) stay enabled during all measurements

corpus.source: fixtures/quick-access/manifest.json perf_corpus recipe (10,000 synthetic names incl. identical leaf names and 12-segment deep paths)
corpus.generation: materialized into a git-ignored synthetic store before measurement

measurements.name: Warm hotkey to search field accepting the first keystroke
measurements.notes: Verify a typed first character is present in the field, not merely that the window painted. Warm = app resident and previously summoned.

measurements.name: Keystroke to correct results painted (10,000 synthetic names after indexing)
measurements.notes: Corpus includes identical leaf names and deeply nested paths; measure after indexing completes; ranking must be stable across samples.

measurements.name: Hidden/locked steady state
measurements.notes: Record idle CPU, UI private bytes, broker private bytes, and wakeups SEPARATELY. Explicitly account for the core residency watchdog while an unlocked session exists. A watchdog that only runs while unlocked is not a steady-state polling violation.

measurements.name: Cold launch to first paint (locked state)
Passphrase unlock + names-only index build
measurements.notes: KDF cost must remain at the store's encoded ops_limit; never reduce cost for the benchmark.

measurements.name: Copy gesture to clipboard publication (broker round-trip incl. exclusions)
Lock request to complete session invalidation (IDs dead, index cleared, clipboard owned content cleared)

harness_contract.command: string with {STORE}, {SAMPLES}, {OUT} placeholders; run by scripts/bench.ps1
harness_contract.output: one latency sample in milliseconds per stdout line (invariant-culture decimal); evidence notes go to {OUT}
harness_contract.missing: harness null or command failing = the row is recorded UNEXECUTED; never estimated
